verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the Message Batches API as a way to asynchronously process large volumes of Messages requests, with a documented 50% cost reduction versus standard calls, which covers both halves of the story: async submission and a stated discount. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch discount, and documented specifics on job submission, polling, result retrieval and turnaround windows or batch rows in the per-model pricing table.
